title: A low regularity exponential-type integrator for the derivative nonlinear Schrödinger equation
summary: In this work, we present a first-order unfiltered exponential integrator for the one-dimensional derivative nonlinear Schrödinger equation with low regularity. Our analysis shows that for any $s>\frac12$, the method converges with first-order in $H^s(\mathbb{T})$ for initial data $u_0\in H^{s+1}(\mathbb{T})$. Moreover, we constructed a symmetrized version of this method that performs better in terms of both global error and conservation behavior.
